title: Change-Order Scope Charges
content:
# Change-Order Scope Charges

Window Replacement Contracts — how the scope of the most recent customer change order sets its change-order fee.

**Rule.** How the change-order fee is figured depends on what the change order does: a change order that adds openings is charged the per-added-opening charge of $40 times the openings it adds, never less than the series change-order fee; a change order that adds no opening but writes two or more lines is charged the series change-order fee plus the extra-line charge of $20 for each line beyond the first; any other change order is charged the series change-order fee.

The lines counted are the customer change-order lines written on the change order's date; an oversize surcharge line is not one of them. The openings added are the openings on its added-opening lines.

## Scope table

| What the change order does | Fee figured as |
|---|---|
| Adds one or more openings | The higher of $40 times the openings added and the series change-order fee |
| Adds no opening, writes 2 or more lines | Series change-order fee plus $20 for each line beyond the first |
| Adds no opening, writes 1 line | Series change-order fee |

## Hypothetical cases (series change-order fee taken as a hypothetical $90)

- Adds 4 openings: $40 times 4 is $160, above $90, so $160.
- Adds 1 opening: $40 is below $90, so $90.
- Adds no opening, writes 3 lines: $90 plus $20 times 2, so $130.
- Adds no opening, writes 1 line: $90.
